method.fixed_rules: EMA480 macro trend, completed-candle signals, EMA72 close exit, prior-5-bar swing stop capped at 4%, 1% risk sizing, 10% notional cap, 3-position cap, 0.85 correlation cap

varied_rules.production_3bar: Current router: ADX >=25, ATR <=3%, close > rising EMA200, stable for 3 closed bars, 2,500 contiguous-hour warmup
varied_rules.single_bar: Same indicators and thresholds as production router, with no 3-bar persistence requirement
varied_rules.breakout_only: No extra regime gate; the existing EMA480 macro filter and breakout signal remain active

caveats: The 2026 review interval has already been examined in this project and is not a clean holdout.
A 12-variant parameter screen creates selection bias; top results are exploratory only.
Hourly OHLCV cannot model actual book depth, queue position, network delay, or exact stop fills.
The fixed BTC/ETH/SOL universe is survivor-biased and excludes other valid markets.
No-halt runs isolate strategy behavior; live frequency must be judged under configured halts.
